samples.humanAnswer: instruments, balance and ending work musically. But: the plain version is different than the former plain versions, why?

scope: Ghostbusters palette on the submitted 53-note Für Elise phrase: instruments, balance and ending. The listener separately questions the changed plain reference.
interpretation: Musical reuse accepted; the plain reference is case-specific, not a fixed recording reused across studies. Ghostbusters uses source-score triangle envelopes with native early gate release and four-call quantization; Airwolf retained its native envelopes and Billie Jean used held/legato plain articulation.
limits: No acceptance of the separate full-title reconstruction, universal patch suitability or identical cross-study reference sound is inferred.

modelAssistanceReview.decision: No model call for this transfer
modelAssistanceReview.reason: The changed reference is explained by explicit generator settings and native scheduling; fine balance and articulation remain outside calibrated model eligibility.
modelAssistanceReview.nextReview: Before case closure; the separate planned speech-recognition trial has a different scope.
